purpose: Shared current MaterialState binding for scoped owners, bounded to Schedule/Actual material facets.

columns.name: scoped_owner_ref
columns.meaning: Scoped owner address whose current facet is bound.

primary_key.name: pk_scoped_current_material_state
primary_key.reason: At most one current binding per scoped owner and facet.

foreign_keys.name: fk_scoped_current_material_state_owner_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind current control to an existing scoped owner address.

foreign_keys.name: fk_scoped_current_material_state_state_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind current control to one exact material-state address.

unique_constraints.name: uq_scoped_current_material_state_material_state_ref
unique_constraints.reason: One MaterialStateRef cannot be current through two scoped current bindings.

check_constraints.name: ck_scoped_current_material_state_facet_code
check_constraints.reason: Keep scoped current bindings bounded to Schedule/Actual material facets.

indexes.name: uq_scoped_current_material_state_material_state_ref
indexes.reason: Unique reverse current binding by MaterialStateRef.

triggers.name: trg_scoped_current_material_state_current_binding
triggers.reason: Database-local enforcement for current MaterialState owner/facet binding.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Points to the accepted current MaterialStateRef; it does not own protected payload.
state_history.current_binding: A retired MaterialStateRef may remain the truthful current reference while material_state_retirement makes payload absence explicit.
state_history.chronology: Facet-specific history preserves currentness chronology independently from payload retention.
state_history.immutability_policy: Direct runtime DML remains denied; mutation is exposed only through bounded current views.

lifecycle.retention: Retain while the current binding is truthful, including when it points to an explicitly retired state.
lifecycle.redaction: Redaction removes protected payload, not the current-reference fact itself.
lifecycle.retirement_tombstone: Resolve the bound MaterialStateRef against dante.material_state_retirement before treating payload absence as ordinary live state.
